title: Podcast Scraper — Pipeline stages (RFC-109)
description: Per-episode processing manifest signal. Requires JSON log lines with event_type=pipeline_stage (RFC-109 / ADR-132), emitted per stage from processing_manifest.update_stage. Correlate by run_id / episode_id.

targets.expr: sum by (stage) (sum_over_time({env="prod"} | json | event_type="pipeline_stage" | unwrap cost_usd [30d]))
sum by (run_id) (sum_over_time({env="prod"} | json | event_type="pipeline_stage" | unwrap cost_usd [30d]))
sum by (stage) (sum_over_time({env="prod"} | json | event_type="pipeline_stage" | unwrap duration_s [7d]))

panels.title: Method-version inventory (reprocess key) — stage writes per stage×version
panels.description: Which stage logic is in play. Counts stage WRITES (≈ episodes on a fresh run; a re-run re-emits, so treat as an inventory of which method_versions exist, not a distinct-episode count). After shipping an improvement, rows on the OLD method_version are the reprocess target (ADR-132 §Convention 2).

panels.title: Flagged stage-writes (24h)
panels.description: Stage writes carrying a rework quality_flag (asr_failover / unnamed_dominant_voice / empty_host_anchor / guest_in_title_not_placed / gi_all_gated / asr_speech_coverage_low). Line-filter on the JSON since the flags ship as an array.

panels.title: Recent flagged episodes
panels.description: Drill-down: the actual flagged stage writes (episode_id / stage / flags) for triage. Pivot to logs/traces/Sentry by run_id / episode_id.
